# `m.stocks.splits`

Stock splits, reverse splits, and stock dividends of US-listed stocks.

```python
m.stocks.splits(symbols=None, *, start=None, end=None, sort=None, order=None, limit=None, filters=None)
```

| --- | --- |
| Verbs | `fetch()`, `poll()` |
| Served by | REST |
| Time range | `start` and `end` are sent as `execution_date.gte` and `execution_date.lte` |
| `poll()` | `dm.PollMode.REPLACE`: holds exactly the latest cycle's rows, keyed by `Id` |

## Plan access

Which of Massive's plans include this dataset, how recent its data is on each, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | Splits (REST) |
| --- | --- |
| Stocks Basic | Updated daily, 2 years |
| Stocks Starter | Updated daily, All history |
| Stocks Developer | Updated daily, All history |
| Stocks Advanced | Updated daily, All history |
| Stocks Business | Updated daily, All history |

## Columns

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. From REST `ticker`: "Stock symbol for the company that executed the split". | REST |
| `RawSymbol` | String | The symbol exactly as Massive sent it, on a row whose spelling the library cannot read as the dataset's class (its `Symbol` is then null); null on every other row. Present unless the session's `unreadable_symbols` is `dm.OnError.RAISE`, which fails on such a row instead. | REST |
| `AdjustmentType` | String | Classification of the share-change event. Possible values include: forward_split (share count increases), reverse_split (share count decreases), stock_dividend (shares issued as a dividend) | REST |
| `ExecutionDate` | String | Date when the stock split takes effect. The adjustment is applied overnight. On the prior trading day, the post-market session is the last session that shows pre-split prices. On the execution date, all trading is already adjusted for the split. This includes the pre-market session. | REST |
| `HistoricalAdjustmentFactor` | double | Cumulative adjustment factor used to offset split effects on historical prices. To adjust a historical price for splits: for a price on date D, find the first split whose `execution_date` is after date D and multiply the unadjusted price by the `historical_adjustment_factor`. | REST |
| `Id` | String | Unique identifier for each stock split event | REST |
| `SplitFrom` | double | Denominator of the split ratio (old shares) | REST |
| `SplitTo` | double | Numerator of the split ratio (new shares) | REST |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, as an Instant: the local clock when the REST page, flat-file block, or WebSocket frame that carried it arrived, the same for every row of one. It is not monotonic and is not Massive's own receive time; on history() rows it is the download time, and in a poll() table the latest poll's. | REST |
